recentItems.title: Searching for Maya Millete | Full Episode + Case by Case Podcasts
recentItems.description:
"48 Hours" and contributor Jonathan Vigliotti report on the 2021 disappearance of Maya Millete, a young California mother and wife, and the case against her husband, Larry Millete, in “Searching for Maya Millete." After years of waiting, Larry Millete went on trial in May 2026, charged with his wife's murder.

After watching the full episode, follow along as "Case by Case" breaks down the evidence, the witnesses, and the unanswered questions that defined this no-body murder trial. From allegations of control and marital conflict to digital evidence and the now-infamous spellcaster testimony, we examine the case that captivated Southern California and beyond. And even with a verdict, the central question remains unanswered: Where's Maya?
